capabilities: Manage character profiles and relationship histories
Track factions, organizations, positions, and territories
Organize story timelines, chapters, and foreshadowing
Export setting collections and manage snapshots
disambiguation: Not only a relationship graph; it is a full novel-writing workbench covering characters, factions, timelines, chapters, and worldbuilding.
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README; local-only with no cloud AI or API key; recommends separate Vault backups; mobile support not fully verified.
motivation: Built for novelists who need to maintain large casts, cross-chapter timelines, organizational systems, historical changes, and extensive world settings over the long term.
problem: Novelists with large casts and complex timelines lack a single place in Obsidian to track characters, relationships, factions, chapters, and continuity.
summary: Local novel-writing workbench that manages characters, relationships, factions, timelines, chapters, foreshadowing, worldbuilding, and story outlines.
